findings.input_admission: Exact80 expected IDs and passed independent actual-review/collector hash join precede analysis; each raw output hash is verified.
findings.population: One complete indexed table per scheme, ghost populations retained, finite charges and exact parent labels. Existing sum and expanded-expression tolerances cover printed charge precision.
findings.origin_conversion: Actual native A.U. coordinates/effective nuclear charges/masses establish each fragment COM and Ne+Q; mu_total adds Q*O, electronic subtracts Ne*O, nuclear adds Zeff*O before differences. Neutral fragment total moments stay unchanged while their electronic/nuclear parts are transformed.
findings.roundoff: COM check includes six-decimal coordinate/origin and three-decimal positive-mass uncertainty. Per-vector converted precision is 5e-10+abs(charge)*5e-7; coefficient absolute values propagate through C/P/B. Nuclear reconstruction additionally includes coordinate rounding. Bounds are prospective and physically justified, not fitted to scientific outcomes.
findings.algebra: Unchanged C=full-ion-shell; P=sum(dimers)-Nion-sum(water); expandedB full-sum(dimers)+(N-1)ion-shell+sum(water). Neutral population differences and nuclear cancellation remain explicit.
findings.failure_preservation: New attempt failures persist source/config/error/cost even before main creates output; pre-existing directories are never mutated by failure handler.
findings.interpretation: Both schemes retained; positive metal-chargeB corresponds to less full-shell electronic population gain than additive pair gains. No unique charge-transfer/energy assignment and no cross-parent vector orientation inference.
